verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web-access API (search, extract, crawl, map, research) consumed by agents and SDKs. It has no concept of user-authored saved automations or workflows, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside this product type's axis. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any saved-automation, versioning or rollback feature that would make the axis apply. Usage logs and project IDs are attribution and analytics, not automation versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
